title: Scaling Session Annotator: operator change catalog & throughput replay
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Purpose: Build a console feature that records operator-initiated scaling sessions as first-class artifacts (Scaling Session Annotator). Each session should capture the sequence of scaling actions, the before/after throughput and latency snapshots, autoscaling policy context, and human annotations. The feature will power an operator-facing change catalog and a replayable timeline to aid incident reviews, postmortems, and capacity planning decisions.

Scope: UI components in Console: (1) a compact session card list filtered by tenant and time range, (2) an expandable timeline view that overlays throughput (TPS, p95 latency) and capacity changes, (3) inline notes/annotations and tagging for runbook references, (4) a modal to step-forward/step-back through scaling events at configurable time granularity, and (5) an exportable audit artifact (JSON + CSV) that can be attached to support tickets. Backend work: persistent session store, lightweight sampling of throughput metrics during sessions, and tying sessions to autoscale policy snapshots.

Acceptance criteria:
- Operators can create a named scaling session or have sessions auto-created when manual scale overrides occur.
- Timeline displays time-correlated throughput, latency, and node count with clear delta highlighting.
- Sessions preserve the autoscaling policy version and allow comparison between policies at time of change.
- Annotation UI supports free text + link to runbook + severity tag.
- Export includes event list, metric snapshots, and annotations.
- Feature passes security review for tenancy isolation and audit log retention.

Trade-offs & decisions: We chose sampled metrics at 15s resolution to avoid heavy storage costs; this means some very short spikes may be blurred but long-running trends and the impact of scaling steps remain visible. We will initially scope annotation search to session text and tags (not full-text across all exports) to reduce indexing costs.

Telemetry & success metrics: adoption by fleet operators (>= 30% of manual scale actions attached to a session in first 6 weeks), time-to-triage reduction (median operator investigation time down by 20%), and correct correlation of throughput delta to scaling event in >85% sampled incidents.
comments: 2026-02-18 — Sofia Martinez: Kickoff notes captured. Product/ENG/Design sync: prioritized session metadata and export format. Agreed to record policy snapshot hash rather than whole policy object to save space. Action: ENG to propose session schema by 2026-02-24.

2026-02-25 — Liam Chen: ENG proposal uploaded (see link). Proposed session document: id, tenant_id, start_ts, end_ts, events[], metrics_samples[], policy_hash, annotations[]. Suggested retention: 90 days by default with configurable TTL per org. Flagging potential N+1 reads on high-churn tenants; recommend incremental writes and batching metrics flush.

2026-03-02 — Priya Kapoor (Design): Initial mocks shared. Key feedback from UX review: keep timeline compact in list view and allow quick expand. Add an affordance to pin sessions to a tenant dashboard. Also suggested color palette for delta highlighting (green for scale-up improving throughput, amber for no-change, red for regression).

2026-03-05 — Security (Jamal Ortiz): Reviewed tenancy isolation and export controls. Request: require session export only for users with 'operator:export' role and ensure exports go through KMS-encrypted storage. Marked security_review_required = true.

2026-03-09 — Liam Chen: Engineering update — backend prototype implemented; session writes and metrics sampling working against a staging tenant. Added a feature flag console.scalingSessionAnnotator=true. Discovered a race when a rapid scale-up is immediately followed by autoscaler correction; engineering suggests showing both events and an inferred "policy-correction" event to clarify intent.

2026-03-11 — PM review (Sofia): Reviewed prototype with SRE. SRE asked for a 'confidence' indicator that notes when metric sampling density is low. Also asked for a CSV format quick-export for customers that use internal spreadsheets. Added to acceptance criteria.

2026-03-12 — Design review (Priya): Updated mocks to include annotation inline editing and a 'link to runbook' quick-add. UX notes: keep session creation modal minimal to encourage use; default name to "Manual scale · <timestamp>".
notes: Rollout plan: gated feature flag, invite-only beta with two enterprise customers (ACME Payments, NimbusAI), one-week internal dogfood period, then gradual ramp. Post-release: monitor adoption and file a follow-up to surface session cost to tenant billing dashboard.
audit_trail_summary: Captures operator-initiated scale overrides and correlates them with sampled throughput/latency. Stores operator annotations and preserves autoscale policy hash for post-incident comparisons. Exports are gated and encrypted.
